google-drive.comment: Copy to ~/.cursor/mcp.json. One-time: place OAuth Desktop app JSON at ~/.config/google-drive-mcp/gcp-oauth.keys.json then run: npx -y @piotr-agier/google-drive-mcp auth

github.comment: Official GitHub remote MCP (OAuth). Copy url block to ~/.cursor/mcp.json, restart Cursor, then approve OAuth on first tool use. Alternative: enable GitHub plugin under Customize → Plugins.
